entries.english: Relations with the Rüdt family, 1573 and 1603–1615. The records concern: the 1573 dispute between Philipp Jakob von Rosenberg and Stefan Rüdt von Bödigheim over the noval tithe at Sindolsheim; Wolf Konrad and Adam Julius Rüdt von Collenberg’s proposed sale of their village of Rüdenau and two farms at Kleinheubach to Count Georg von Erbach (1603); Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg’s mediation in disputes between Christoph Rüdt von Bödigheim and Philipp Ernst von Berlichingen zu Sennfeld concerning Bernhard von Wichsenstein’s daughter (1604–1605); and marital disputes of Ruffina von Berlichingen, née Rüdt von Bödigheim, wife of Georg Philipp von Berlichingen, and her claims against the guardianship of the children of her late brother Hans Rüdt von Bödigheim, including Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg (1608–1615). One volume.
